title: Tiny, cute jack-o'-lantern
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="pumpkinGrad" cx="50%" cy="45%" r="55%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ff8c00"/>
      <stop offset="60%" stop-color="#ff6a00"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#e04e00"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id="glowGrad" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#ffe066"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#ffb300"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  
  <!-- Stem -->
  <path d="M48 22 Q50 14 54 16 Q56 18 52 24" fill="#6b8e23" stroke="#8fbf3a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  
  <!-- Pumpkin body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="58" rx="32" ry="28" fill="url(#pumpkinGrad)"/>
  
  <!-- Pumpkin ridges -->
  <path d="M50 30 Q44 58 50 86" fill="none" stroke="#ffa040" stroke-width="1.8" opacity="0.7"/>
  <path d="M36 34 Q32 58 38 82" fill="none" stroke="#ffa040" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.5"/>
  <path d="M64 34 Q68 58 62 82" fill="none" stroke="#ffa040" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.5"/>
  
  <!-- Left eye -->
  <polygon points="34,48 42,44 44,54 36,56" fill="url(#glowGrad)"/>
  <polygon points="34,48 42,44 44,54 36,56" fill="none" stroke="#ffcc00" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- Right eye -->
  <polygon points="66,48 58,44 56,54 64,56" fill="url(#glowGrad)"/>
  <polygon points="66,48 58,44 56,54 64,56" fill="none" stroke="#ffcc00" stroke-width="1"/>
  
  <!-- Cute little nose -->
  <polygon points="50,54 47,60 53,60" fill="url(#glowGrad)"/>
  
  <!-- Smiling mouth with teeth -->
  <path d="M36 66 Q40 74 50 76 Q60 74 64 66" fill="none" stroke="#ffcc00" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <rect x="40" y="66" width="5" height="6" rx="1" fill="url(#glowGrad)"/>
  <rect x="55" y="66" width="5" height="6" rx="1" fill="url(#glowGrad)"/>
  
  <!-- Cheek blush -->
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="62" rx="5" ry="3.5" fill="#ff8a8a" opacity="0.5"/>
  <ellipse cx="70" cy="62" rx="5" ry="3.5" fill="#ff8a8a" opacity="0.5"/>
  
  <!-- Highlight on pumpkin -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="40" rx="8" ry="5" fill="#ffcc66" opacity="0.25" transform="rotate(-20 40 40)"/>
</svg>
